stanza: And the night comes again to the circle-studded sky
The stars settle slowly, in loneliness they lie
'Til the universe explodes as a falling star is raised
Planets are paralyzed, the mountains are amazed
But they all glow brighter from the brilliance of the blaze
With the speed of insanity, then he dies

brilliance.linePrev: And made this dancing child who tears through the days
brilliance.line: With a brilliance you would have deepened and sang along with
brilliance.lineNext: But you're sleeping out in the yard now
stanza: Everybody that used to know us seems concerned
But if they knew that when you went through my mind
I'm full of the love that illuminated our house for all those years
And made this dancing child who tears through the days
With a brilliance you would have deepened and sang along with
But you're sleeping out in the yard now
